name: In-N-Out Burger Dean Martin Drive

sources.observed: Official address and drive-through/dine-in service; separate company store identified.
Official low-resolution exterior inspected: white stucco, stepped entrance masses, terracotta caps, red awnings and patio.
Location-specific entrance photo inspected in Restaurantji gallery: raised tiled entry bay, paired doors/transom, red awnings, low red tile band.
Location-specific patio/long elevation inspected: multiple red awnings, pale concrete picnic tables, red/white umbrellas, two raised tiled masses and ringed pylon sign. Photo date unknown.
Aerial inspected: east/west elongated restaurant, separate company store to north, south patio/parking, drive-through loop east. Neighboring building excluded.
Smaller roadside arrow sign above short masonry wall/black fence inspected; differs from ringed tall pole visible in other photographs. Exact positions not yet established.

Location-specific Restaurantji gallery photo 13 inspected full-size: white square tables, red round spindle-back chairs, grey square floor tiles with dark grout, metal cone pendant lamps, white walls and low grey wainscot. Outdoor umbrellas visible through windows. Photo date unknown; does not establish complete floor plan.

uncertainDimensions: 393.01m2 mapped footprint. Heights, exact awning divisions and patio dimensions require photographic estimates.
Public room dimensions and ordering-counter placement inferred; photograph supports finish/furniture only. Kitchen and staff spaces remain closed.
implemented: Original mapped restaurant shell with two raised tiled entrance bays, red awnings, transparent mullioned glazing, continuous stepped cornice and red tile band, patio and five concrete picnic-table/umbrella groups.

Reference-supported public dining study: white square tables, red spindle-back chairs, grey tile floor and wainscot, pendant shades, inferred public ordering counter; two automatic entrances. No kitchen or private-room access.
remaining: Public dining layout and counter placement are inferred, not measured; kitchen/staff rooms intentionally inaccessible. Fine furniture, menu and finish fidelity remain unfinished.
Locate and implement both roadside sign types and full site boundary/landscape details without disturbing road or company store.
Exact rear service/drive-through treatment and roof equipment layout remain estimated.
Photo-perfect material, glass/frame finish and furniture fidelity are not achieved; no completion claim.

evidence.observed: Five installed neutral-daylight views inspected. Corrected opaque glazing and chair backs. Final trim restoration inspected in patio, west and dining captures at build/city-exteriors/inout-dean-martin-trim.

routes: Public dining entry and cross aisle

performance.note: Final packaged fresh-bake run: three matching exterior views plus two room views. Baseline exterior p50 16.6–16.8, p95 18.2–18.7.
